title: Old Walking Animation Reborn
description: This mod restores the classic, derpy arm-flailing walking animation from Minecraft's early Indev days.
body:
# Old Walking Animation (Unofficial Update)

A modern, client-side update of the classic "Old Walking Animation" mod, bringing back the beloved "derpy" arm-flailing animations from the early Indev days of Minecraft!

## Features
- **Nostalgic Animations:** Restores the wild, diagonal arm-swinging animations for players (and optionally humanoid mobs).
- **Client-Side Only:** Works completely client-side. You can join any server and see the classic animations!
- **Mod Compatibility:** Updated and tested for Minecraft 1.21 up to 1.21.11 (Fabric).
